title: Degreewise locally linear signed Cech projection
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $M$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], $r\in\mathbb N$, and $W:\operatorname{ULift}(\operatorname{Fin} r)\to X.\mathrm{Opens}$ a finite family. Let $D$ be a nonnegative complex of module sheaves, and $e_p$ identify the global-scalar underlying presheaf of $D^p$ with the all-tuple Cech product presheaf, as in [def-pc-ordered-cech-module-coordinates]. Write $c_{p,B,y}(s)$ for the $y$ product coordinate of $e_p(s)$, a section of $M$ on $(\prod_l W_{y_l})\times B$. Assume $c_{p,B,y}(a s)$ is the restriction of $a\in\Gamma(B,\mathcal O_X)$ along the second projection times $c_{p,B,y}(s)$ for every $p,B,y,s,a$. Define $v_{p,B,y}(s)$ as the finite sum over permutations $\sigma$ for which $l\mapsto(y_{\sigma l}).\mathrm{down}$ is strictly increasing, with coefficient $\mathrm{sign}(\sigma)$, restricting $c_{p,B,y\sigma}(s)$ first to the increasing intersection and then back to the full product intersection. Both arrows are the canonical containments of opens. Other summands are zero. There exists a family $Q_p:D^p\to D^p$ of module-sheaf morphisms with $c_{p,B,y}(Q_p s)=v_{p,B,y}(s)$ for all $p,B,y,s$. No compatibility with the differentials of $D$ is assumed or asserted.

source.place: Tag 01FK, Lemma on ordered projection; Tag 01FM, the map cπ

proof.text: For each degree define the restriction natural transformation R for a permutation passing the strict filter. Its component is coefficient restriction along the composite of the full-product-to-ordered-intersection arrow and ordered-intersection-to-sorted-product arrow. Naturality follows by composing restriction maps; the arrows agree since opens form a poset. Form c by Pi.lift of the finite signed sums of e followed by the appropriate projection and R, and put phi=c followed by e inverse. Pi.lift_pi and e inverse identities give the required coordinate formula.

To prove local linearity apply e, then all product coordinates after evaluation on B. Evaluation preserves this product and Concrete.isLimit_ext gives coordinate injectivity. Expand the signed sum. Apply the assumed local scalar equation to the sorted coordinate and map_smul to each of the two restrictions. The scalar restriction composite equals the full-product second projection by uniqueness of arrows. Integer scalar multiplication commutes with local scalar multiplication. Finite sums preserve the equality. Use PresheafOfModules.homMk to lift phi to a morphism of presheaves of local modules, and wrap it as a module-sheaf map. The entire construction and coordinate proof are proved in Lean; choose the family from these proved degreewise existence statements.

theorem orderedCech_degreewise_projection_exists {X' : Scheme.{u}}
    (M : X'.Modules) {r : ℕ} (W₀ : ULift.{u} (Fin r) → X'.Opens)
    (D : CochainComplex X'.Modules ℕ)
    (e : ∀ p : ℕ, (PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op).obj
          (D.X p).val ≅
        ((cechComplexFunctor W₀).obj
          ((prod.functor (C := X'.Opens)).op ⋙ Functor.opHom _ _ ⋙
            (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj
              M.presheafModuleCat)).X p)
    (hlinear : ∀ (p : ℕ) (y : Fin (p + 1) → ULift.{u} (Fin r)) (B : X'.Opens),
        let c : Γ(D.X p, B) → Γ(M, (∏ᶜ fun l ↦ W₀ (y l)) ⨯ B) :=
          fun s ↦ ((e p).hom ≫ Pi.π (fun y : Fin (p + 1) → ULift.{u} (Fin r) ↦
            ((prod.functor (C := X'.Opens)).op ⋙ Functor.opHom _ _ ⋙
              (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj
                M.presheafModuleCat).obj
                (op (∏ᶜ fun l ↦ W₀ (y l)))) y).app (op B) s
        ∀ (a : Γ(X', B)) (s : Γ(D.X p, B)),
          c (a • s) = X'.presheaf.map (prod.snd :
            (∏ᶜ fun l ↦ W₀ (y l)) ⨯ B ⟶ B).op a • c s)
    : ∃ Q : ∀ p : ℕ, D.X p ⟶ D.X p,
      IsOrderedCechNaturalProjection M W₀ D e Q
